<script type="text/javascript">
  Salla.onReady(() => {
    (() => {
      
      const allowed_pages = ["thank-you"]; 
      const title = {"ar":"شاهدتها مؤخرا","en":"watched it recently"};
      const limit = "32";
      const lang = salla.config.get('user')?.language_code || 'ar';

      const injectSection = () => {
        console.log("allowed_pages:", allowed_pages);
        console.log("title:", title[lang]);
        console.log("limit:", limit);

        const slug = salla.config.get("page")?.slug;
        if (!allowed_pages.includes(slug)) return null;

        let section = document.getElementById("viewed-section");
        if (section) return section;

        const footer = document.querySelector(".store-footer");
        if (!footer) return null;

        const html = `
          <section id="viewed-section" class="s-block container mt-6 sm:mt-8">
            <div class="s-block__title">
              <div class="right-side">
                <h2>${title[lang]}</h2>
              </div>
            </div>

            <salla-products-slider autoplay id="viewed-products-list" source="selected" limit="${limit}"></salla-products-slider>
          </section>
        `;

        footer.insertAdjacentHTML("beforebegin", html);
        return document.getElementById("viewed-section");
      };

      const initViewedProducts = () => {
        const section = document.getElementById("viewed-section");
        const list = document.getElementById("viewed-products-list");

        if (!section || !list) return;

        if (!window.salla?.storage || !window.salla?.config) {
          section.style.display = "none";
          return;
        }

        const storeId = salla.config.get("store")?.id;
        const key = "s-viewed-products-" + storeId;

        const products = salla.storage.get(key) || [];
        const currentProductId = salla.config.get("page")?.id;

        if (!Array.isArray(products) || products.length === 0) {
          section.style.display = "none";
          return;
        }

        const filteredProducts = currentProductId
          ? products.filter((product) => {
              const productId = (product && product.id) ? product.id : product;
              return String(productId) !== String(currentProductId);
            })
          : products;

        if (filteredProducts.length === 0) {
          section.style.display = "none";
          return;
        }
        
        const limitedProducts = filteredProducts.slice(0, 32);

        list.setAttribute("source-value", JSON.stringify(limitedProducts));
        section.style.display = "";
      };

      const run = () => {
        const section = injectSection();
        if (!section) return;
        initViewedProducts();
      };

      if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", run);
      } else {
        run();
      }
    })();
  });
</script>

            translateAll: 'Traduire tous les commentaires en français',

          },
          de: {

            translateAll: 'Alle Kommentare ins Deutsche übersetzen',

          es: {

            revert: 'Ver original',
            translating: 'Traduciendo...',
            failed: 'Traducción fallida',
            translateAll: 'Traducir todos los comentarios al español',

          },
          tr: {

            revert: 'Orijinali gör',

          }
        };

        return all[key] || {
          translate: 'Translate',
          revert: 'See original',
          translating: 'Translating...',
          failed: 'Translation failed',
          translateAll: 'Translate all',
          revertAll: 'See originals'
        };
      }

      function isEmptyCommentText(text) {
        return !String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, '').trim();
      }

      async function translateText(text, target) {
        const cleanText = String(text || '').trim();

        if (isEmptyCommentText(cleanText)) {
          return {
            translated: '',
            detected: ''
          };
        }

        const cacheKey = `${target}::${cleanText}`;

        if (translationCache.has(cacheKey)) {
          return translationCache.get(cacheKey);
        }

        const url =
          'https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single' +
          '?client=gtx' +
          '&sl=auto' +
          '&tl=' + encodeURIComponent(target) +
          '&dt=t' +
          '&q=' + encodeURIComponent(cleanText);

        try {
          const res = await fetch(url);

          if (!res.ok) {
            throw new Error('Translation request failed');
          }

          const data = await res.json();

          const result = {
            translated: (data?.[0] || []).map(function (part) {
              return part?.[0] || '';
            }).join(''),
            detected: data?.[2] || ''
          };

          translationCache.set(cacheKey, result);
          return result;
        } catch (error) {
          return {
            translated: cleanText,
            detected: '',
            error: true
          };
        }
      }

      function getCommentTextElement(comment) {
        return (
          comment.querySelector('.s-comments-item-content p') ||
          comment.querySelector('.s-comments-item-content') ||
          comment.querySelector('p')
        );
      }

      function getCommentsContainer() {
        return (
          document.querySelector('.s-comments-container') ||
          document.querySelector('.s-comments') ||
          document.querySelector('salla-comments') ||
          document.querySelector('[class*="comments"]')
        );
      }

      function getAllComments() {
        return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('salla-comment-item'));
      }

      function isSameAsWebsiteLanguage(comment) {
        const detectedLang = comment.dataset.lang || '';

        if (!detectedLang) {
          return false;
        }

        return langBase(detectedLang) === langBase(userLang);
      }

      function updateGlobalRowVisibility() {
        const row = document.querySelector('.s-translate-all-wrap');

        if (!row) return;

        const comments = getAllComments();

        const hasTranslatableComment = comments.some(function (comment) {
          const textElement = getCommentTextElement(comment);
          const original = comment.dataset.originalText || textElement?.textContent?.trim() || '';

          if (isEmptyCommentText(original)) return false;

          const detectedLang = comment.dataset.lang || '';

          if (!detectedLang) return false;

          return langBase(detectedLang) !== langBase(userLang);
        });

        row.style.display = hasTranslatableComment ? '' : 'none';
      }

      function ensurePerCommentControls(comment) {
        if (!comment || comment.nodeType !== 1) return;

        const textElement = getCommentTextElement(comment);

        if (!textElement) return;

        const currentText = textElement.textContent.trim();
        let existingWrap = comment.querySelector(':scope .s-translate-wrap');

        if (isEmptyCommentText(currentText)) {
          if (existingWrap) existingWrap.remove();

          comment.dataset.skipTranslate = 'true';
          comment.dataset.originalText = '';
          comment.dataset.lang = '';
          updateGlobalRowVisibility();
          return;
        }

        comment.dataset.skipTranslate = 'false';

        if (!comment.dataset.originalText) {
          comment.dataset.originalText = currentText;
        }

        let wrap = existingWrap;

        if (!wrap) {
          wrap = document.createElement('div');
          wrap.className = 's-translate-wrap';
          textElement.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', wrap);
        }

        if (!wrap.dataset.ready) {
          wrap.innerHTML = `
            <button type="button" class="s-translate-btn" data-action="translate">
              <span>${labels.translate}</span>${ICON}
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="s-translate-btn" data-action="revert" style="display:none;">
              <span>${labels.revert}</span>${ICON}
            </button>
          `;

          wrap.dataset.ready = 'true';
        }

        const translateBtn = wrap.querySelector('[data-action="translate"]');
        const revertBtn = wrap.querySelector('[data-action="revert"]');

        if (!translateBtn || !revertBtn) return;

        if (comment.dataset.isTranslated === 'true') {
          translateBtn.style.display = 'none';
          revertBtn.style.display = '';
        }

        if (!comment.dataset.langDetecting && !comment.dataset.lang) {
          comment.dataset.langDetecting = 'true';

          translateText(comment.dataset.originalText, userLang).then(function (result) {
            comment.dataset.lang = result.detected || '';
            comment.dataset.langDetecting = 'false';

            const sameLang = isSameAsWebsiteLanguage(comment);

            if (sameLang && comment.dataset.isTranslated !== 'true') {
              translateBtn.style.display = 'none';
              revertBtn.style.display = 'none';
            } else if (comment.dataset.isTranslated !== 'true') {
              translateBtn.style.display = '';
              revertBtn.style.display = 'none';
            }

            updateGlobalRowVisibility();
          });
        } else {
          const sameLang = isSameAsWebsiteLanguage(comment);

          if (sameLang && comment.dataset.isTranslated !== 'true') {
            translateBtn.style.display = 'none';
            revertBtn.style.display = 'none';
          }
        }

        updateGlobalRowVisibility();
      }

      function ensureGlobalRow() {
        const container = getCommentsContainer();

        if (!container) return;

        const hasComments = !!document.querySelector('salla-comment-item');

        let header =
          container.querySelector('.s-comments-header') ||
          container.querySelector('[class*="comments-header"]') ||
          container.firstElementChild;

        let row = container.querySelector('.s-translate-all-wrap');

        if (!hasComments) {
          if (row) row.remove();
          return;
        }

        if (!row) {
          row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 's-translate-all-wrap';
          row.style.display = 'none';

          row.innerHTML = `
            <button type="button" class="s-translate-btn" data-action="translate-all">
              <span>${labels.translateAll}</span>${ICON}
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="s-translate-btn" data-action="revert-all" style="display:none;">
              <span>${labels.revertAll}</span>${ICON}
            </button>
          `;

          if (header) {
            header.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', row);
          } else {
            container.insertAdjacentElement('afterbegin', row);
          }
        }

        updateGlobalRowVisibility();
      }

      async function translateComment(comment) {
        const textElement = getCommentTextElement(comment);

        if (!textElement) return;

        const original = comment.dataset.originalText || textElement.textContent.trim();

        if (isEmptyCommentText(original)) {
          const wrap = comment.querySelector(':scope .s-translate-wrap');
          if (wrap) wrap.remove();
          return;
        }

        const sameLang = isSameAsWebsiteLanguage(comment);

        if (sameLang) return;

        const result = await translateText(original, userLang);

        if (!result.error && result.translated) {
          textElement.textContent = result.translated;
          comment.dataset.isTranslated = 'true';
        }

        const wrap = comment.querySelector(':scope .s-translate-wrap');

        if (wrap) {
          const translateBtn = wrap.querySelector('[data-action="translate"]');
          const revertBtn = wrap.querySelector('[data-action="revert"]');

          if (translateBtn && revertBtn) {
            translateBtn.style.display = 'none';
            revertBtn.style.display = '';
          }
        }
      }

      function revertComment(comment) {
        const textElement = getCommentTextElement(comment);

        if (!textElement) return;

        const original = comment.dataset.originalText;

        if (!isEmptyCommentText(original)) {
          textElement.textContent = original;
        }

        comment.dataset.isTranslated = 'false';

        const wrap = comment.querySelector(':scope .s-translate-wrap');

        if (wrap) {
          const translateBtn = wrap.querySelector('[data-action="translate"]');
          const revertBtn = wrap.querySelector('[data-action="revert"]');

          const sameLang = isSameAsWebsiteLanguage(comment);

          if (translateBtn && revertBtn) {
            revertBtn.style.display = 'none';
            translateBtn.style.display = sameLang ? 'none' : '';
          }
        }
      }

      function mount() {
        getAllComments().forEach(ensurePerCommentControls);
        ensureGlobalRow();
        updateGlobalRowVisibility();
      }

      document.addEventListener('click', async function (event) {
        const btn = event.target.closest('.s-translate-btn');

        if (!btn) return;

        const action = btn.dataset.action;

        if (action === 'translate' || action === 'revert') {
          const comment = btn.closest('salla-comment-item');

          if (!comment) return;

          const wrap = btn.closest('.s-translate-wrap');
          const translateBtn = wrap?.querySelector('[data-action="translate"]');

          if (action === 'translate') {
            const span = translateBtn?.querySelector('span');
            const oldText = span ? span.textContent : '';

            if (translateBtn) translateBtn.disabled = true;
            if (span) span.textContent = labels.translating;

            await translateComment(comment);

            if (translateBtn) translateBtn.disabled = false;
            if (span) span.textContent = oldText;

            updateGlobalRowVisibility();
          }

          if (action === 'revert') {
            revertComment(comment);
            updateGlobalRowVisibility();
          }

          return;
        }

        if (action === 'translate-all' || action === 'revert-all') {
          const bar = btn.closest('.s-translate-all-wrap');

          if (!bar) return;

          const translateAllBtn = bar.querySelector('[data-action="translate-all"]');
          const revertAllBtn = bar.querySelector('[data-action="revert-all"]');

          const comments = getAllComments();

          if (action === 'translate-all') {
            const span = translateAllBtn?.querySelector('span');
            const oldText = span ? span.textContent : '';

            if (translateAllBtn) translateAllBtn.disabled = true;
            if (span) span.textContent = labels.translating;

            for (const comment of comments) {
              await translateComment(comment);
            }

            if (translateAllBtn) {
              translateAllBtn.disabled = false;
              translateAllBtn.style.display = 'none';
            }

            if (span) span.textContent = oldText;
            if (revertAllBtn) revertAllBtn.style.display = '';

            return;
          }

          if (action === 'revert-all') {
            comments.forEach(revertComment);

            if (revertAllBtn) revertAllBtn.style.display = 'none';
            if (translateAllBtn) translateAllBtn.style.display = '';

            updateGlobalRowVisibility();
          }
        }
      });

      mount();

      let raf;

      const observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        cancelAnimationFrame(raf);

        raf = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
          mount();
        });
      });

      observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
      });
    });
  }

  initCommentsTranslation();
})();
